# Arya Suneesh

> NLP Engineer at TIFIN RM, AI researcher, and quantum computing enthusiast. Undergraduate of IIIT Kottayam with international research experience in Munich and Berlin.

Arya Suneesh is an NLP Engineer and AI researcher focused on multilingual natural language processing, production machine learning systems, and quantum computing applications. She has published research at SemEval-2025 and CLEF 2025, and has conducted quantum computing research at the Munich Center for Quantum Science and Technology (MCQST).
